title: Serum Immunometabolic Biomarkers Reveal Distinct Phenotypes in Chronic Urticaria
content: Methods: Forty CU patients and 40 healthy controls were evaluated. Clinical parameters included disease severity, disease subtype, antihistamine response, IgE levels, anti-TPO status, gastrointestinal symptoms, and angioedema. Serum levels of histamine, intestinal fatty acid-binding protein (IFABP), soluble CD14 (sCD14), diamine oxidase (DAO), D-lactic acid, endotoxin, zonulin, calprotectin, and related ratios were measured. Disease activity and control were assessed using the UAS7 and UCT scores.
